name: LeadPulse Editorial Celebration Layer
scope: Reference-only visual layer for milestone, empty, completion, and onboarding-moment screens. It does not replace LeadPulse's action-first CRM surfaces.

inspiration_analysis.genre: Mobile editorial reward screen, not a dense infographic or operational dashboard
inspiration_analysis.core_effect: One joyful outcome gets a calm, poster-like moment: short label, large serif statement, supporting reassurance, one expressive illustration, one action.
visual_formula: High-contrast serif headline in two or three short lines
Plain sans-serif reassurance copy with one bold proof point
Single large central illustration with thick dark outlines and a small warm accent palette
One full-width dark primary action anchored near the bottom
do_not_copy: The source illustration, character, copy, or exact composition
A generic human avatar in place of LeadPulse's approved mascot system

use_for: First customer or first completed interaction
A deliberately calm empty state with one next step
do_not_use_for: Tables, filters, form editing, or dense CRM details
Warnings, errors, destructive confirmation, or overdue work
product_role.leadpulse_rule: Operational pages stay compact and action-first. This layer appears only when a user should pause, understand one positive state, then take one clear next step.

canvas.role: Warm paper backdrop, with ample unframed whitespace

quiet_lavender.role: Eyebrow chip and gentle celebratory background

primary_action.role: Optional brand-forward action treatment; use the existing dark-ink CTA when the screen needs maximum calm

attention_ochre.role: Small celebratory spark or progress accent only

decorative_coral.role: Small illustration accent only, never error semantics

danger.role: Reserved for real danger and destructive actions, never celebration

editorial_headline.use: Celebration or calm-empty-state headline only, never dense CRM labels

body_emphasis.use: One proof point or reassurance, not an additional headline

eyebrow.use: Short state label, two to three words maximum

metadata.use: Optional dates, count, or compact outcome metadata

spacing.section_rhythm: Use 24px, 32px, or 48px steps. Never crowd this layer with dashboard-card spacing.

shape.shadow: none by default; use a very soft 0 8px 24px rgba(43,33,26,0.08) only when a surface must separate from the canvas

layout.alignment: centered text and illustration; primary action spans the content width

rules.headline: Use a human outcome, not a metric dump. Example structure: ‘You cleared today’s queue.’
rules.supporting_copy: One sentence plus one optional bold reassurance or proof point.
rules.illustration: One focal visual only. It should consume visual space, not introduce more information.
rules.detail: One short line, 140 characters maximum. Put audit/history detail behind the next screen.
rules.cta: One action only. Secondary navigation should be a quiet text link or the back gesture, not a second button.

illustration.direction: Flat editorial joy can inform composition and color blocking, but LeadPulse keeps its existing approved fixed PNG mascot family.
rules: Use one mascot at a time and give it generous breathing room.
Do not generate a new AI person, avatar, clay letter, or replacement mascot from this reference.
A small CSS-only sparkle/confetti accent is allowed on genuine success, but it must not obscure text or keep looping.
Illustration never communicates critical CRM status by itself. The headline and text must state the outcome.

primary_cta.label_style: Verb-first and specific: ‘Open action board’, ‘Review the deal’, ‘Log next touch’

motion.principle: A single calm reveal, not gamified movement.

interaction.success_accent: One 600ms non-looping sparkle burst at most
interaction.reduced_motion: Render all elements immediately with no transform, scale, sparkle, or stagger.

accessibility.contrast: All normal text must meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 against its actual surface. Do not rely on pastel lavender, mint, coral, or ochre text alone.
accessibility.tap_targets: Primary action minimum 48px high, supporting actions minimum 44px.
accessibility.semantic_order: Headline is an h1 or h2 appropriate to the route. The mascot has meaningful alt text only when it conveys the outcome; otherwise use empty alt text.
accessibility.focus: Primary CTA has a visible 2px focus ring that remains clear on the warm canvas and dark mode.
accessibility.dark_mode: Use the existing midnight-cocoa canvas and warm ink. Do not paste the bright-white source screen into dark mode.

deal_won.support_pattern: The deal is closed won and the sales signal is recorded.

import_complete.support_pattern: Possible duplicates remain visible for your approval. Nothing was merged automatically.

guardrails: This is a ceremonial layer, not a global LeadPulse reskin.
Preserve the warm night-desk palette, action-first information hierarchy, explicit Save feedback, and dark-mode contrast.
Do not apply display-serif typography to Deal board cards, tables, filters, or editing forms.
Do not use celebration visual language for overdue work, missing data, errors, or destructive actions.
No implementation or asset changes are authorized by this JSON alone.
